records.name: Ask Iris
records.tagline: Private visual AI assistant for Apple devices
records.description: Ask Iris is a private visual AI workspace for Mac, iPhone, and iPad. Attach screenshots, images, PDFs, camera captures, or short clips; ask questions; save useful Visual Clips; and choose models that run locally on your device. Chats, attachments, and inference stay on-device unless you choose a network action like downloading a model.

records.name: GenMB
records.tagline: AI app builder with a real backend and automations
records.description: GenMB turns a plain-English prompt into a complete, deployed web app: frontend, backend functions, database, and auth included. Then it goes further than generation - automate your app with a visual workflow builder (20+ node types), scheduled agents that run Python on cron, chat agents on Telegram/Slack/Email, and 80 integrations across 15 categories. Free tier includes 8 credits a day and a real Postgres database, no card required.

records.name: CGPA Calculator
records.tagline: Fast, accurate CGPA calculator for students worldwide
records.description: Stop guessing your grades. CGPA Calculator helps students accurately calculate CGPA, GPA, SGPA, and percentage across multiple grading systems. It supports universities worldwide, including Bangladesh's leading institutions like NSU, BRAC University, BUET, DU, and many more. Free, fast, privacy-friendly, and built for students who want accurate results, academic planning tools, and helpful grading guides, all in one place.

records.name: Marezi
records.tagline: Africa's AI Intelligence for Customer Experience
records.description: Marezi is Africa’s adaptive AI customer experience platform, helping organizations manage high-volume service delivery across 15+ African countries, including Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Zimbabwe, DR Congo, Ghana, Ethiopia, and Nigeria. Its solutions include appointment booking, queue management, virtual queuing, self-service kiosks, and digital signage.

records.name: LinkedIn Focus
records.tagline: Block the LinkedIn feed. Keep your focus.
records.description: Block the distracting LinkedIn feed during work hours or anytime you need focus Block the distracting LinkedIn feed and stay focused. Customizable schedules, quick breaks, full access to Jobs, Messages, Notifications, etc. Stop endless scrolling. Start being productive. LinkedIn Feed Blocker helps you take control of your LinkedIn experience by blocking the addictive feed while keeping full access to the features that actually matter: Jobs, Messages, Notifications, and your Network.

records.name: GenofX
records.tagline: GenofX is a free Cloud to run heavy Softwares and Apps!
records.description: GenofX Cloud OS is a free Cloud platform to host heavy softwares and webapps in your private dashboard for free! Run VS code, blender, n8n or openclaw. Everything is free with a centralized file manager for storage which makes it a complete Cloud OS.

records.name: myCloudGarage
records.tagline: Vehicle Inventory Dashboard & AI Document Parsing
records.description: Shop software is built for big chains and still makes you type receipts by hand. myCloudGarage is for independents: used-car dealers, body shops, tint and mod shops. Snap a photo of any receipt or invoice and AI pulls the vendor, totals, and line items, then files it under the right vehicle, so you know what every car actually cost you. Inventory, invoices, checklists, and customers in one place. Cloud or on-prem. 14-day free trial, start in under a minute.

records.name: Commity: GPS Accountability
records.tagline: Show up or pay up. Miss a day? Earn your 66% back.
records.description: Pick a goal and pin the location on a map. Back it with a small stake and when you arrive, tap "I'm here". GPS confirms you're actually there(app notifies you when you are near the location). Hit your daily minute goal → $0 charged. Skip a scheduled day → stake is charged. Miss a day → You get 30 days to start a comeback - just 5 completed sessions across the next 5 weeks, and 66% of your stake bounces back. It's completely free, you only pay your stake if you miss scheduled day.

records.name: Wedding Photographer Pro
records.tagline: QR photo galleries for wedding photographers
records.description: SnapTheKnot Photographer Pro helps wedding photographers offer couples a branded QR code photo and video gallery. Guests scan one QR code, upload from their phones without an app, and the couple gets one private gallery. Photographers can use it as an easy package add-on with custom branding, QR signs, downloads, and white-glove setup help.

records.name: Book Kaal Sarp Puja at Trimbakeshwar
records.tagline: Sacred Rituals, Trusted Hands, Peaceful Life
records.description: If you are looking for a genuine and peaceful puja experience, Trimbakeshwar is the right destination for you. The Kaal Sarp Puja in Trimbakeshwar is performed at the sacred Jyotirlinga temple and is believed to bring positive changes in life by removing the ill effects of Rahu and Ketu. Pandit Govind Shastri has earned the trust of thousands of devotees through his sincere and dedicated service over the years.

records.name: Collab Creator AI
records.tagline: Ride the trend before it peaks
records.description: Collab Creator AI eliminates the guesswork of content creation. Unlike standard SEO tools that just show historical keyword volume, our AI actively spots emerging YouTube trends before they peak. What makes us stand out: Predictive Intelligence: Catch viral trends early. AI Ideation: Generate data-backed video concepts instantly. Gap Analysis: Discover untouched niches. Built for creators who want to lead the algorithm, not chase it.

records.name: ComplianceOS Scalegrowth
records.tagline: Content compliance made easy; Fight AI Slop!
records.description: ComplianceOS automates content review for regulated industries. Marketing teams get instant feedback on regulatory rules, brand voice, and factual accuracy. Our system runs text through three separate AI models to find errors. You get exact rewrite suggestions to fix violations immediately. This stops costly compliance fines before you publish. It cuts down long legal review wait times completely.

records.name: Islam365: Quran, Dua & Prayer
records.tagline: Islam365 is a free, ad-free Islamic companion app
records.description: Islam365- Your Complete Islamic Companion Read Quran, track prayer times, find the Qibla instantly, watch Live Makkah & Madina, and strengthen your daily Deen all in one beautifully designed Islamic app. Islam365 is a modern Islamic app built for Muslims around the world. Whether you are looking for a complete Quran app, accurate prayer times, Qibla finder, Islamic Duas, or Live Haramain streaming, Islam365 provides a beautiful, fast, and distraction-free experience for everyday Islamic life.

records.name: Webhosters
records.tagline: Know the Best Ones in Web Hosting
records.description: WebHosters is a comprehensive web hosting directory and discovery platform that helps businesses, developers, and website owners find the right hosting provider. The platform brings together thousands of hosting companies, allowing users to compare services, read verified customer reviews, explore different hosting categories, and make informed purchasing decisions.

records.name: Drawing Prompts
records.tagline: Drawing Prompts That Actually Get You Drawing
records.description: From silly doodles to serious character designs—we've got a prompt for every mood. Pick a category and get your first prompt instantly.
